## Summary
Implements an in-app trading card collection system where users can earn cards based on achievements and milestones.

### Changes
- Created database migration \(007_trading_cards.sql\) with three new tables:
  - `trading_cards`: Stores card definitions with rarity, artwork, and metadata
  - `user_trading_cards`: Tracks which cards users have collected
  - `card_rewards`: Defines requirements for earning cards
- Added Go models for trading cards with CRUD operations
- Implemented API handlers for:
  - `GET /cards`: List all available cards
  - `GET /me/cards`: List user''s card collection
  - `POST /me/cards/:id/claim`: Claim an earned card
  - `GET /me/cards/progress`: Track progress toward earning cards
- Included 10 starter cards with various rarities and reward conditions

### Test plan
- [ ] Verify database migration runs successfully
- [ ] Test GET /cards endpoint returns all trading cards
- [ ] Test GET /me/cards endpoint returns user-owned cards
- [ ] Test POST /me/cards/:id/claim validates requirements before granting cards
- [ ] Test GET /me/cards/progress shows accurate progress tracking
- [ ] Verify cards can be earned based on games_played and games_won conditions
- [ ] Check that duplicate card claims are properly rejected
